topics.inclusion_rule: Lip-reading, VSR or AVSR decoders of the one filtered population (ledger names optical-camera input and lip reading, VSR or AVSR; non-decoders removed), classified by the visual model their full text names: CNN on mouth images, learned deep features (CNN, DBN, autoencoder, DNN), neural network with phonetic or viseme units (TDNN, ANN/HMM), phoneme a posteriori features, hand-crafted appearance or shape features, HMM classifier. Boundary: a study counts under every design its text names, related-work mentions included (upper bound); versions count once; dated against 2014-09.
topics.pattern: published table pattern (optical camera + lip-reading terms)

topics.inclusion_rule: The same filtered lip-reading decoder population, classified by the evaluation partition the full text names: speaker-independent (held-out speakers), speaker-dependent (same speakers), random frame-level train/test split, cross-validation or jackknife, and whether a standard deviation, confidence interval or significance test is reported. Boundary: a study counts under every partition its text names, related-work mentions included (upper bound); versions count once; dated against 2014-09.
